title: xi ability recipe
description: What `xi ability compose` reads and the model viewer's Ability Mixer writes: lanes of retail sources plus the commands of the new `main` routine at absolute frames. See docs/ability/mixer.md.

dir.description: 4-char name of the effect directory written around the sections (default: the first four alphanumerics of name).

target.description: How the recipe is meant to be published. `xi dats` records the numbers it allocated here on the published copy.

total.description: The routine's totalDelay (its end). A recipe from `xi ability recipe` carries the source's own so the header round-trips; otherwise the last event's start + duration is used.

sources.description: One lane per key (motion / vfx / sound are the mixer's; any name works). A `ws:N` spec without a race is race-bound: the recipe composes once per race.

routine.description: Routine tag the lane's events are read from.

name.description: Display name (the mixer keeps the catalog entry's).

events.description: One command each in the new `main` routine, in any order (sorted by start, then `order`).

spec.description: Anything `xi ability inspect` accepts: ja:N, spell:N, ws:N[:Race], fid:N, ROM/x/y, or a path.

datId.description: 4-char section id the command names (clip `b00?` with the client's `?` wildcard, generator `g004`, sound pointer `8050`, routine `mdam`).

from.description: Lane (a key of `sources`) the command and its sections come from.

op.description: Routine opcode (docs/fx/effect_system.md §3): 0x05 clip, 0x02 generator, 0x0A/0x0B sound, 0x03 link, 0x2C trace, 0x1E dampen…

start.description: Absolute frame (60/s routine ticks). The writer turns it back into the format's relative delays.

dur.description: The command's duration field (emit window, lock length, clip window).

order.description: Tie-break for events on the same start frame.

loops.description: Clip (0x05) only: 0 = loop forever, N = play N times then hold.

raw.description: Exact source command bytes (from `inspect --json`). Wins over routine/offset and op/ref lookup.

routine.description: With `offset`: the source routine the command is copied from.

offset.description: With `routine`: byte offset of the command inside that routine's sec2.
